_comment: Copy to liveness-hosts.local.json (gitignored) to extend posting-liveness host handling without publishing your board list.
_sessionGated: Hosts that only show real posting state to a signed-in session. Any text-based verdict from them is discarded; only HTTP 404/410 counts as expired. Use this for boards that serve login walls or bot challenges to unauthenticated fetches.
_uncertainOnAmbiguous: Hosts whose CDN or bot detection can return HTTP 200 with no expiry or active signal. A pattern-free 200 from these falls back to uncertain instead of active. Explicit expiry and active matches are still trusted.
